summary: DNR camping + main page, Widen campground map and closures feed read; GoingToCamp unread (403). 96 sites, electric count 29 (text) vs 33 (map); amperage unposted. Showers/flush/vault/water/dump confirmed. Not waterfront confirmed. Water systems off for the season until spring 2027 (normal seasonal shutdown). Pin at the campground entrance; keep.
flags: ELECTRIC COUNT: page says 29 electric sites, the DNR map marks 33 (2-9, 33-41, 44-46, 49-51, 54-56, 63, 85-87, 89-91). Amperage is not posted anywhere read; hookups left unwritten (stored hookups absent).
SEASON: no campground season dates on the DNR pages (park open year-round 6 a.m.-11 p.m.); GoingToCamp unread (Azure 403). Season not written.

STATUS: closures feed - water systems (showers, flush toilets, fountains, dump) shut down for the season, back on spring 2027; boat launch piers out Nov 16, 2026. Normal off-season; no status written.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - the campground lies in the woods north of the park office; the lake, beach and boat launch are ~0.6-1 mile south ('within 1 mile of the campground').

PIN: 42.9792,-89.2351 sits at the campground entrance by the office/shower area; the loops run north and north-east under continuous canopy and cannot be placed from imagery (no catalog coordinates; Google's 42.97956,-89.23437 is the same spot). Keep.
